close_reason: Replaced both unwrap_or escapes in handle_contact_card_copy with proper error handling: the to_value() call uses .expect() matching the existing precedent (derive(Serialize) on plain data is infallible), and the from_value() failure now surfaces as invalidProperties in notCopied so the client sees the patch failure rather than a silently-swallowed error. New unit test covers the deserialize-failure path. Implementation in commit ab8f41e.
title: card.rs:428,437 unwrap_or(Value::Null) and unwrap_or(card) silently swallow serialize/deserialize errors mid-copy
